title: Improper Access Control Applied to Mirrored or Aliased Memory Regions in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV)…
description: CVE-2026-28247 is a medium severity vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware involving improper access control on mirrored or aliased memory regions. This flaw could allow a malicious hypervisor with high privileges to alter the encryption bit of guest context pages, potentially compromising the integrity of the guest environment.
